name: Isolde
bio: Archetype: Phase Build-Up, AFK Buff, Extra Action. ⌽ Grants [Preignition] to all allies, allowing them to inflict [Burn] on attack. ⌽ Changes phase based on the total number of [Burn] stacks resolved. Becomes stronger with each phase change. ⌽ Final phase: Automatically applies [Power Burst] to all allies and casts [Intermezzo] against [Burn]ed enemies every turn. ⌽ S2 reduces enemy Crit DEF and Reality DEF. ⌽ Ultimate grants all allies [Rousing Morale], inflicts burn on all enemies and casts [Intermezzo]. Excess [Burn] inflicted on the main target is instead converted into Incantation Might for this [Intermezzo].
